# Gravity Dam Overturning Check: **APPROVE** (FS ≈ 2.01, required ≥ 1.5)

## 1. Geometry and lines of action (written before any calculation)

**Reference frame:** The heel (upstream base corner) is at x = 0, and the toe is at x = B = 27.95 m. All moments are taken about the **toe**. Horizontal lever arms are measured from the toe, and the vertical lever arm is measured up from the base.

**Section layout:**
- The upstream face is vertical at x = 0.
- The rectangle runs from x = 0 to x = 3.6 m and spans the full height of 34.1 m.
- The downstream triangle has its vertical side at x = 3.6 m, against the rectangle. Its base runs from x = 3.6 m to the toe, a width of 27.95 − 3.6 = 24.35 m. Its height is 34.1 m, and its hypotenuse slopes down to the toe.

| Load | Direction | Line of action | How located | Lever arm about toe |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| W₁, rectangle weight | Down | x = 3.6/2 = 1.80 m from heel | Centroid of a rectangle is at mid-width | 27.95 − 1.80 = **26.150 m** |
| W₂, triangle weight | Down | x = 3.6 + 24.35/3 = 11.717 m from heel | Centroid of a right triangle is ⅓ of its base from the vertical (right-angle) side | 27.95 − 11.717 = **16.233 m** (= ⅔ × 24.35) |
| P, water thrust | Horizontal, downstream | 32.4/3 = 10.80 m above base | Triangular hydrostatic pressure; resultant at h/3 from the base | **10.800 m** (vertical arm) |
| U, uplift | Up | x = B/3 = 9.317 m from heel | Triangular distribution, maximum at heel and zero at toe; centroid at ⅓B from the large end | 27.95 − 9.317 = **18.633 m** (= ⅔B) |

There is no vertical water load on the upstream face because that face is vertical.

## 2. Forces and moments (per metre length)

**Resisting moments (self-weight):**
- W₁ = 24 × 3.6 × 34.1 = 2,946.2 kN. Moment = 2,946.2 × 26.150 = 77,044 kN·m.
- W₂ = 24 × ½ × 24.35 × 34.1 = 9,964.0 kN. Moment = 9,964.0 × 16.233 = 161,749 kN·m.
- **ΣM_R = 238,793 kN·m**

**Overturning moments:**
- P = ½ × 9.81 × 32.4² = 5,149.1 kN. Moment = 5,149.1 × 10.80 = 55,610 kN·m.
- Uplift pressure at the heel = 0.76 × 9.81 × 32.4 = 241.56 kPa.
- U = ½ × 241.56 × 27.95 = 3,375.8 kN. Moment = 3,375.8 × 18.633 = 62,903 kN·m.
- **ΣM_O = 118,513 kN·m**

## 3. Factor of safety

FS_overturning = 238,793 / 118,513 = **2.01**

## 4. Verdict: **APPROVE**

FS = 2.01 ≥ 1.5, so the section satisfies the overturning criterion with a margin of about 34%.

**Notes:**
- Uplift contributes more overturning moment than the water thrust in this case, about 63,000 versus 56,000 kN·m. The result is therefore sensitive to the uplift factor of 0.76. That value should be backed by the drainage and grouting design.
- This approval covers **overturning only**, as specified. Sliding resistance, base pressure, and the position of the resultant within the middle third have not been checked here. - Uplift pressure at the heel = 0.54 × 9.81 × 25 = 132.44 kPa

|---|---|---|---|
| **W₁, rectangle** (5.3 × 24.9) | Vertical line through its centroid, x = 5.3/2 = 2.65 m from heel | Centroid of a rectangle is at mid-width | 18.76 − 2.65 = **16.11 m** |
| **W₂, triangle** (base 13.46, height 24.9) | Vertical side at x = 5.3 m, sloping face meets the toe. Centroid is 1/3 of the triangle base from the vertical side: x = 5.3 + 13.46/3 = 9.787 m | Triangle centroid lies 1/3 of the base from the right-angle (vertical) side | 18.76 − 9.787 = **8.973 m** |
| **P, horizontal water thrust** | Triangular pressure on the vertical upstream face. Resultant acts at h/3 = 23.1/3 = **7.70 m** above the base | Centroid of a triangular pressure diagram | Vertical lever arm = **7.70 m** |
| **U, uplift** | Triangular, maximum at the heel, zero at the toe. Resultant acts at B/3 = 6.253 m from the heel | Centroid of the triangle lies nearer its large end | 18.76 − 6.253 = **12.507 m** (= 2B/3) |

# Gravity Dam Overturning Check: **APPROVE** (FS ≈ 1.98, required 1.5)

## 1. Geometry and lines of action

All moments are taken about the **toe**. I placed the heel at x = 0 and the toe at x = B = 18.76 m, so a lever arm about the toe is 18.76 − x.

- **Rectangle** (crest block, 5.3 m wide × 24.9 m high): it spans x = 0 to 5.3 m. Its centroid is at mid-width, x = 2.65 m. Lever arm = 18.76 − 2.65 = **16.11 m**.
- **Downstream triangle**: it has a vertical side at x = 5.3 m, runs down to the toe, and has base 18.76 − 5.3 = 13.46 m. A triangle's centroid lies one-third of the base from its vertical side, so x = 5.3 + 13.46/3 = 9.787 m. Lever arm = **8.973 m**.
- **Water thrust** (horizontal, on the vertical upstream face): the pressure is triangular over the 23.1 m depth, so the resultant acts at h/3 = **7.70 m** above the base. That height is the lever arm about the toe.
- **Uplift** (triangular, maximum at the heel, zero at the toe): the resultant acts at B/3 = 6.253 m from the heel. Lever arm = 2B/3 = **12.507 m**.

## 2. Forces (per metre length)

| Load | Calculation | Force (kN) | Arm (m) | Moment (kN·m) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| W₁ rectangle | 24 × 5.3 × 24.9 | 3,167.3 | 16.110 | 51,024.9 (resisting) |
| W₂ triangle | 24 × ½ × 13.46 × 24.9 | 4,021.8 | 8.973 | 36,089.4 (resisting) |
| P water | ½ × 9.81 × 23.1² | 2,617.4 | 7.700 | 20,153.7 (overturning) |
| U uplift | ½ × 0.9 × 9.81 × 23.1 × 18.76 | 1,913.1 | 12.507 | 23,925.9 (overturning) |

Totals:
- Resisting moment ΣM_R = **87,114 kN·m**
- Overturning moment ΣM_O = **44,080 kN·m**

## 3. Factor of safety

FS_overturning = 87,114 / 44,080 = **1.98**

This is at least 1.5, so the overturning criterion is satisfied with about 32% margin above the required value.

## Verdict: **APPROVE** (for overturning only)

Notes:
- Uplift contributes more overturning moment than the water thrust. The result is therefore sensitive to the uplift factor of 0.9. Drainage that reduced uplift would increase the margin.
- This approval covers overturning only. Sliding, base pressures (whether the resultant falls in the middle third) and the load cases excluded here (tailwater, silt, seismic) should be checked separately before final approval.

Coordinates: the heel (upstream face) is at x = 0 and the toe at x = B = 10.09 m. The rectangle spans x = 0 to 4.3 m. The downstream triangle spans x = 4.3 to 10.09 m (base 5.79 m). Its vertical side is at x = 4.3 m and its hypotenuse slopes down to the toe.

| Load | How the line of action is located | Lever arm from toe |
|---|---|---|
| W₁, rectangle | Centroid at mid-width, x = 4.3/2 = 2.15 m from heel | 10.09 − 2.15 = **7.94 m** |
| W₂, triangle | Centroid one-third of its base from the vertical (thick) side: x = 4.3 + 5.79/3 = 6.23 m. This is two-thirds of the base from the toe. | (2/3)(5.79) = **3.86 m** |
| P, water thrust (horizontal) | Triangular hydrostatic pressure, so the resultant acts at h/3 above the base | 12.2/3 = **4.067 m** (vertical arm) |
| U, uplift | Triangle with maximum at the heel and zero at the toe, so the centroid is B/3 from the heel | (2/3)(10.09) = **6.727 m** |

## Forces and moments (per metre length)

**Resisting moments:**
- W₁ = 24 × 4.3 × 13 = 1341.6 kN, giving M = 1341.6 × 7.94 = 10,652 kN·m
- W₂ = 24 × ½ × 5.79 × 13 = 903.2 kN, giving M = 903.2 × 3.86 = 3,486 kN·m
- **ΣM_R = 14,139 kN·m**

- P = ½ × 9.81 × 12.2² = 730.1 kN, giving M = 730.1 × 4.067 = 2,969 kN·m
- Heel uplift pressure = 0.96 × 9.81 × 12.2 = 114.9 kPa

- Uplift is a large share of the overturning moment (about 57%), because the uplift factor is high (0.96) and the uplift acts at a long lever arm. Any change in drainage assumptions would affect the result noticeably.

- The rectangle runs from x = 0 to 3.6 m and is 24.7 m tall.

| Load | Line of action | How it was located |
|---|---|---|
| W₁ (rectangle) | 18.43 − 1.8 = **16.63 m** from toe | Centroid at mid-width, 3.6/2 = 1.8 m from heel |

| U (uplift) | (2/3)(18.43) = **12.287 m** from toe | Triangular pressure, maximum at the heel and zero at the toe, so the resultant acts at B/3 from the heel |

- W₁ = 24 × 3.6 × 24.7 = 2134.1 kN
- M = 2134.1 × 16.63 = 35,490 kN·m

P (water thrust):
- P = ½ × 9.81 × 22.1² = 2395.7 kN
- M = 2395.7 × 7.367 = 17,648 kN·m

- U = ½ × 156.1 × 18.43 = 1438.4 kN

**ΣM_O = 35,322 kN·m**

## 1. Lines of action, measured from the toe

Moments are taken about the **toe**. The heel is at x = 0 and the toe at x = B = 26.35 m. Each horizontal lever arm below is the distance from the toe.

| Load | Location of line of action | How it was located | Lever arm about toe |
|---|---|---|---|
| **W₁: rectangle** (4.4 m × 39.1 m) | Vertical line through its centroid, 4.4/2 = 2.2 m from the heel | Centroid of a rectangle is at mid-width | 26.35 − 2.2 = **24.15 m** |
| **W₂: downstream triangle** (base 26.35 − 4.4 = 21.95 m, height 39.1 m) | Vertical line through its centroid. The right angle is at the vertical side (x = 4.4 m), so the centroid is 21.95/3 = 7.317 m from that side, at x = 11.717 m | Centroid of a right triangle is ⅓ of the base from the right-angle side, i.e. ⅔ of the base from the toe vertex | 26.35 − 11.717 = **14.633 m** (= ⅔ × 21.95) |
| **P: horizontal water thrust** | Horizontal line h/3 = 35.7/3 = 11.9 m above the base | Triangular hydrostatic pressure acts at its centroid, ⅓ of the depth up from the base | **11.9 m** (vertical arm) |
| **U: uplift** (triangular, maximum at heel, zero at toe) | Vertical line through the centroid of the pressure triangle, B/3 = 8.783 m from the heel | Centroid of a triangle is ⅓ of the base from the large end | 26.35 − 8.783 = **17.567 m** (= ⅔B) |

The upstream face is vertical, so no water sits on the dam and there is no vertical water load.

## 2. Forces (per metre length)

- W₁ = 24 × 4.4 × 39.1 = **4,128.96 kN**
- W₂ = 24 × ½ × 21.95 × 39.1 = **10,298.94 kN**
- P = ½ × 9.81 × 35.7² = **6,251.37 kN**
- Heel uplift pressure = 0.74 × 9.81 × 35.7 = 259.16 kPa
- U = ½ × 259.16 × 26.35 = **3,414.44 kN**

## 3. Moments about the toe

**Resisting moments**
- W₁: 4,128.96 × 24.15 = 99,714 kN·m
- W₂: 10,298.94 × 14.633 = 150,708 kN·m
- **Total resisting = 250,422 kN·m**

**Overturning moments**
- P: 6,251.37 × 11.9 = 74,391 kN·m
- U: 3,414.44 × 17.567 = 59,981 kN·m
- **Total overturning = 134,372 kN·m**

## 4. Factor of safety

FS_overturning = 250,422 / 134,372 = **1.86 ≥ 1.5** ✔

## Verdict: **APPROVE**

The dam meets the overturning criterion with a margin of about 24% above the required 1.5.

This approval covers overturning only, under the stated assumptions (no tailwater, silt or seismic loads). A full design review would also need to check:
- sliding,
- the resultant falling within the middle third (no tension at the heel),
- foundation bearing pressure.

Uplift accounts for about 45% of the overturning moment, so this result depends on the 0.74 uplift factor. That factor should be backed by working drainage measures.

# Gravity Dam Overturning Check: **REJECT**

**FS_overturning ≈ 1.27, which is below the required 1.5.**

## Geometry and moment point

- The origin is at the **heel** (upstream face), with x positive downstream.
- The **toe** is at x = B = 17.65 m. All moments are taken about the toe, so each lever arm below is a horizontal or vertical distance from the toe.
- The **rectangle** spans x = 0 to 4 m and is 34.1 m high.
- The **triangle** has its vertical leg at x = 4 m (34.1 m high) and slopes down to the toe. Its base is 17.65 − 4 = 13.65 m.

## Lines of action (measured from the toe)

| Load | How located | Lever arm from toe |
|---|---|---|
| W₁, rectangle | Centroid at mid-width, x = 2.0 m from heel | 17.65 − 2.0 = **15.65 m** (horizontal) |
| W₂, triangle | Centroid at 1/3 of its base from the vertical leg, x = 4 + 13.65/3 = 8.55 m from heel. Equivalently, 2/3 of 13.65 m from the toe. | 17.65 − 8.55 = **9.10 m** (horizontal) |
| P, water thrust | Triangular hydrostatic pressure over h = 31.5 m, so the resultant acts at h/3 above the base | 31.5/3 = **10.50 m** (vertical) |
| U, uplift | Triangle with its maximum at the heel and zero at the toe, so the centroid is B/3 from the heel | 2B/3 = 2(17.65)/3 = **11.767 m** (horizontal) |

## Forces (per metre length)

- **W₁** = 24 × 4 × 34.1 = 3,273.6 kN
- **W₂** = 24 × ½ × 13.65 × 34.1 = 5,585.6 kN
- **P** = ½ × 9.81 × 31.5² = 4,867.0 kN
- **Uplift pressure at the heel** = 0.92 × 9.81 × 31.5 = 284.3 kPa
- **U** = ½ × 284.3 × 17.65 = 2,508.9 kN

## Moments about the toe

**Resisting moments:**
- W₁: 3,273.6 × 15.65 = 51,231.8 kN·m
- W₂: 5,585.6 × 9.10 = 50,828.8 kN·m
- **ΣM_R = 102,060.6 kN·m**

**Overturning moments:**
- P: 4,867.0 × 10.50 = 51,103.8 kN·m
- U: 2,508.9 × 11.767 = 29,521.6 kN·m
- **ΣM_O = 80,625.4 kN·m**

## Factor of safety

FS = 102,060.6 / 80,625.4 = **1.27** < 1.50

## Decision: **REJECT**

The section has only about 85% of the required overturning safety. Uplift is a major contributor: with the 0.92 uplift factor it accounts for about 37% of the overturning moment.

Possible remedies:
- **Reduce uplift** with foundation drainage or a grout curtain. This would lower the uplift factor substantially, which is often the most effective fix.
- **Widen the base or flatten the downstream slope.** This increases both the self-weight and its lever arm.
- **Increase the crest width.** This adds weight with a long lever arm about the toe.

Once revised, the design should also be checked for sliding and for base pressures (resultant within the middle third). Those checks are not covered here.

|---|---|---|

| **P: water thrust** (triangular pressure over 36.9 m depth) | It acts at h/3 above the base. | 36.9/3 = **12.30 m** (vertical) |
| **U: uplift** (triangle, maximum at the heel, zero at the toe) | Its centroid is at B/3 from the heel, which is ⅔B from the toe. | ⅔ × 19.53 = **13.02 m** (horizontal) |

- W₁ = 3.6 × 39.2 × 24 = 3,386.9 kN. Moment = 3,386.9 × 17.73 = **60,049 kN·m**
- W₂ = ½ × 15.93 × 39.2 × 24 = 7,493.5 kN. Moment = 7,493.5 × 10.62 = **79,581 kN·m**
- **Total resisting moment = 139,630 kN·m**

- P = ½ × 9.81 × 36.9² = 6,678.7 kN. Moment = 6,678.7 × 12.30 = **82,148 kN·m**
- Uplift pressure at the heel = 0.68 × 9.81 × 36.9 = 246.15 kPa.

- **Total overturning moment = 113,444 kN·m**

FS = 139,630 / 113,444 = **1.23**

The water thrust alone produces about 59% of the resisting moment. Uplift then removes most of the remaining margin.

# Gravity Dam Overturning Check: **REJECT**

FS_overturning ≈ **1.12**, which is below the required 1.5.

## 1. Lines of action, measured from the toe

Coordinates: x = 0 at the heel (upstream face), x = 9.1 m at the toe. The upstream face is vertical, so the crest rectangle sits against it.

| Load | Location of resultant | How it was located | Lever arm about toe |
|---|---|---|---|
| **W₁: rectangle** (5.6 × 22.4) | Centroid at mid-width, x = 5.6/2 = 2.8 m from heel | Centroid of a rectangle | 9.1 − 2.8 = **6.300 m** |
| **W₂: downstream triangle** (base 3.5 m, from x = 5.6 to 9.1) | Vertical edge at x = 5.6; centroid is 1/3 of the base from that edge, x = 5.6 + 3.5/3 = 6.767 m | Centroid of a right triangle lies 1/3 of its base from the right-angle side | 9.1 − 6.767 = **2.333 m** (= ⅔ × 3.5) |
| **P: horizontal water thrust** | Triangular pressure over 20.3 m; resultant at h/3 above the base | Centroid of a triangular pressure diagram | Vertical arm **6.767 m** (20.3/3) |
| **U: uplift** | Triangular, maximum at heel, zero at toe; resultant at B/3 from the heel | Centroid of the triangle is nearer the large end | 9.1 − 3.033 = **6.067 m** (= ⅔B) |

## 2. Forces

- W₁ = 24 × 5.6 × 22.4 = **3010.56 kN**
- W₂ = 24 × ½ × 3.5 × 22.4 = **940.80 kN**
- P = ½ × 9.81 × 20.3² = **2021.30 kN**
- Heel uplift pressure = 0.95 × 9.81 × 20.3 = 189.19 kPa
- U = ½ × 189.19 × 9.1 = **860.80 kN**

## 3. Moments about the toe

**Resisting moments**
- W₁: 3010.56 × 6.300 = 18,966.5 kN·m
- W₂: 940.80 × 2.333 = 2,195.2 kN·m
- **Total resisting = 21,161.7 kN·m**

**Overturning moments**
- P: 2021.30 × 6.767 = 13,677.5 kN·m
- U: 860.80 × 6.067 = 5,222.2 kN·m
- **Total overturning = 18,899.7 kN·m**

## 4. Factor of safety

FS = 21,161.7 / 18,899.7 = **1.12 < 1.5**

## Conclusion: **REJECT**

The section does not meet the overturning criterion. Several features of the design contribute to this:

- **The base is narrow.** B/H = 9.1/22.4 ≈ 0.41. Typical gravity dams have B/H of about 0.7–0.8.
- **The uplift is severe.** An uplift factor of 0.95 means there is essentially no drainage. Uplift alone contributes about 28% of the overturning moment.
- **Much of the weight sits far from the toe in lever terms.** The heavy rectangle is concentrated near the heel, but the downstream triangle is small and contributes little resisting moment.

**Possible remedies to evaluate:**
- Widen the base. Extending the downstream slope is the most effective option.
- Install a drainage gallery or curtain to reduce the uplift factor. A factor of about 0.33–0.5 is common with drains.
- Add a heel extension or upstream batter so that water weight on the upstream face adds to the resisting moment.

Any revised design should also be checked for sliding and for the middle-third (no-tension) criterion. With these loads, the resultant almost certainly falls outside the middle third.

## Geometry and Lines of Action (moments about the toe)

Origin is at the **toe** (x = 0), with x measured horizontally toward the heel (x = B = 18.58 m) and y measured vertically up from the base.

| Load | How located | Lever arm from toe |
|---|---|---|
| **W₁, rectangle** (4.4 m × 38.2 m) | It sits against the vertical upstream face, spanning x = 14.18 to 18.58 m. Its centroid is at mid-width: 18.58 − 4.4/2. | **16.38 m** (horizontal) |

| **P, water thrust** (horizontal) | The pressure diagram is triangular over depth h = 34.5 m. The resultant acts at h/3 above the base. | **11.50 m** (vertical) |
| **U, uplift** (vertical, upward) | The pressure diagram is triangular, maximum at the heel and zero at the toe. The resultant is B/3 from the heel, which is 2B/3 from the toe. | **12.387 m** (horizontal) |

## Forces

- W₁ = 24 × 4.4 × 38.2 = **4,033.9 kN**
- W₂ = 24 × ½ × 14.18 × 38.2 = **6,500.1 kN**
- P = ½ × 9.81 × 34.5² = **5,838.2 kN**
- Heel uplift pressure = 0.82 × 9.81 × 34.5 = 277.5 kPa
- U = ½ × 277.5 × 18.58 = **2,578.2 kN**

## Moments about the Toe

**Resisting moments:**
- W₁: 4,033.9 × 16.38 = 66,076 kN·m
- W₂: 6,500.1 × 9.453 = 61,448 kN·m
- **Total resisting = 127,524 kN·m**

**Overturning moments:**
- P: 5,838.2 × 11.50 = 67,139 kN·m
- U: 2,578.2 × 12.387 = 31,935 kN·m
- **Total overturning = 99,075 kN·m**

## Result

FS_overturning = 127,524 / 99,075 = **1.29 < 1.5**

## Decision: **REJECT**

The section does not have enough self-weight moment to resist the water thrust together with the high uplift (factor 0.82). Possible fixes include:

- **Widen the base.** This raises the self-weight moment. Note that it also increases uplift.
- **Reduce uplift with drainage or a grout curtain.** Cutting the uplift factor to about 0.3–0.4 would roughly halve the uplift moment.

# Gravity Dam Overturning Check: **REJECT** (FS ≈ 1.16 < 1.5)

## 1. Lines of action, measured from the toe

The reference point is the **toe**, the downstream end of the base. The heel is 15.02 m upstream of it.

| Load | How located | Lever arm from toe |
|---|---|---|
| **W₁: rectangle** (3.8 m × 32.9 m) | The vertical upstream face puts the rectangle at the heel. Its centroid is 3.8/2 = 1.90 m from the heel, so 15.02 − 1.90. | **13.12 m** (horizontal) |
| **W₂: downstream triangle** (base 15.02 − 3.8 = 11.22 m, height 32.9 m) | Its vertical side is at the back of the crest and it tapers to the toe. The centroid is ⅓ of 11.22 m from the vertical side, which is ⅔ × 11.22 from the toe. | **7.48 m** (horizontal) |
| **P: water thrust** (horizontal) | The hydrostatic pressure diagram is triangular. Its resultant acts at h/3 above the base: 30.8/3. | **10.267 m** (vertical) |
| **U: uplift** (triangular, maximum at heel) | The centroid of the triangle is B/3 from the heel, which is 2B/3 = ⅔ × 15.02 from the toe. | **10.013 m** (horizontal) |

The upstream face is vertical, so the water exerts no vertical load on the dam.

## 2. Forces (per metre run)

- W₁ = 24 × 3.8 × 32.9 = **3,000.5 kN**
- W₂ = 24 × ½ × 11.22 × 32.9 = **4,429.7 kN**
- P = ½ × 9.81 × 30.8² = **4,653.1 kN**
- Uplift pressure at the heel = 0.64 × 9.81 × 30.8 = 193.37 kPa
- U = ½ × 193.37 × 15.02 = **1,452.2 kN**

## 3. Moments about the toe

**Resisting moments**
- W₁: 3,000.5 × 13.12 = 39,366 kN·m
- W₂: 4,429.7 × 7.48 = 33,134 kN·m
- **Total = 72,500 kN·m**

**Overturning moments**
- P: 4,653.1 × 10.267 = 47,772 kN·m
- U: 1,452.2 × 10.013 = 14,542 kN·m
- **Total = 62,313 kN·m**

## 4. Factor of safety

FS_overturning = 72,500 / 62,313 = **1.16**

## Verdict: **REJECT**

FS = 1.16 is well below the required 1.5. The section is too slender for a 30.8 m reservoir:
- The water thrust alone produces about two-thirds of the resisting moment.
- Uplift adds a further 23% to the overturning moment.

Possible remedies:
- Widen the base. This adds weight and lengthens the lever arms, though it also increases the uplift.
- Reduce uplift with drainage or a grout curtain. A lower uplift factor helps directly.
- Add mass upstream, for example a battered upstream face so that water weight bears on the dam.

Uplift reduction alone is not sufficient. Even with zero uplift, FS = 72,500 / 47,772 = 1.52, which only marginally passes. The base width will most likely need to increase.

- U: 1,452.2 × 10.013 = 14,542 kN·m

| **U, uplift** (triangle: maximum at the heel, zero at the toe) | **10.727 m** horizontally from the toe | The centroid is B/3 from the heel, the high-pressure end, which is 2B/3 from the toe. Lever arm = (2/3)(16.09) = 10.727 m |

- H: 4,622.9 × 10.233 = 47,308 kN·m
- U: 2,204.8 × 10.727 = 23,651 kN·m
- **Total overturning = 70,958 kN·m**

## 1. Lines of action (moments about the toe)

**Datum:** the toe, at the downstream end of the base. Horizontal lever arms are measured upstream from the toe. Vertical lever arms are measured up from the base. The heel is 9.98 m from the toe.

| Load | Line of action | How it was located |
|---|---|---|
| **W₁: rectangle** (5 m wide × 23.2 m high) | 9.98 − 5/2 = **7.48 m** from toe | The rectangle sits against the vertical upstream face, so it runs from the heel to 5 m downstream. Its centroid is at mid-width, 2.5 m from the heel. |
| **W₂: downstream triangle** (base 9.98 − 5 = 4.98 m, height 23.2 m) | (2/3)(4.98) = **3.32 m** from toe | The vertical side is at 4.98 m from the toe and the apex is at the toe. A triangle's centroid is ⅓ of its base from the vertical side, which is ⅔ of 4.98 m from the toe. |
| **P: water thrust** (horizontal) | 20.6/3 = **6.867 m** above base | Hydrostatic pressure is triangular, so the resultant acts at h/3 above the base. |
| **U: uplift** (triangular, maximum at heel) | (2/3)(9.98) = **6.653 m** from toe | The centroid of the pressure triangle is ⅓B from the heel (the large end), which is ⅔B from the toe. |

## 2. Forces

- W₁ = 5 × 23.2 × 24 = **2784.0 kN**
- W₂ = ½ × 4.98 × 23.2 × 24 = **1386.4 kN**
- P = ½ × 9.81 × 20.6² = **2081.5 kN**
- Uplift pressure at heel = 0.85 × 9.81 × 20.6 = 171.77 kPa
- U = ½ × 171.77 × 9.98 = **857.1 kN**

## 3. Moments about the toe

**Resisting moments**
- W₁: 2784.0 × 7.48 = 20,824 kN·m
- W₂: 1386.4 × 3.32 = 4,603 kN·m
- **ΣM_R = 25,427 kN·m**

**Overturning moments**
- P: 2081.5 × 6.867 = 14,293 kN·m
- U: 857.1 × 6.653 = 5,703 kN·m
- **ΣM_O = 19,996 kN·m**

## 4. Factor of safety

FS = 25,427 / 19,996 = **1.27 < 1.5**

## Conclusion

**REJECT.** The dam does not meet the overturning criterion. Its resisting moment is about 15% short of what FS = 1.5 requires (about 29,990 kN·m is needed).

The base width of 9.98 m is narrow for a 23.2 m dam (B/H ≈ 0.43). Typical ratios are about 0.7–0.8.

- **Widen the base.** This lengthens the lever arm of the weight.
- **Reduce uplift.** A drainage gallery or grout curtain would lower the uplift factor.

**Reference point:** all moments are taken about the **toe**, the downstream base corner. Horizontal distances are measured upstream from the toe. Vertical distances are measured up from the base.

**Coordinates:** the heel (upstream base corner) is at x = 0 and the toe at x = B = 17.47 m. The upstream face is vertical.

| Load | Shape / distribution | How the line of action was located | Lever arm about toe |
|---|---|---|---|
| W₁, rectangle (5.2 × 37.6 m) | Occupies x = 0 to 5.2 m | Centroid at mid-width, x = 2.6 m from heel → 17.47 − 2.6 | **14.87 m** (horizontal) |

## 1. Lines of action (moments taken about the toe)

| Load | Location of line of action | How it was located |
|---|---|---|
| **W₁: rectangle** (3.6 m wide × 31.9 m high) | Centroid is 1.8 m from the heel. Lever arm from toe = 13.16 − 1.8 = **11.36 m** | A rectangle's centroid is at its mid-width. The rectangle sits against the vertical upstream face. |
| **W₂: downstream triangle** (base 13.16 − 3.6 = 9.56 m, height 31.9 m) | Centroid is 9.56/3 = 3.187 m downstream of the rectangle's downstream edge, so x = 6.787 m from the heel. Lever arm from toe = (2/3)(9.56) = **6.373 m** | A triangle's centroid lies one-third of its base from the vertical (right-angle) side. Here that side is at x = 3.6 m, and the sloping face runs to the toe. |
| **P: water thrust** (horizontal) | **H/3 = 27.6/3 = 9.20 m** above the base | The hydrostatic pressure diagram is triangular, so its resultant acts at one-third of the water depth above the base. |
| **U: uplift** (vertical, upward) | Centroid is B/3 = 4.387 m from the heel. Lever arm from toe = (2/3)(13.16) = **8.773 m** | The uplift diagram is triangular, with its maximum at the heel and zero at the toe. Its centroid is therefore one-third of the base from the heel. |

- **ΣM_R = 54,634 kN·m**

- Uplift pressure at the heel = 0.79 × 9.81 × 27.6 = 213.9 kPa

# Gravity Dam Overturning Check: **REJECT**

FS_overturning ≈ **1.10**, which is below the required 1.5.

## Geometry and lines of action

**Reference point:** all moments are taken about the **toe** (downstream base corner). Horizontal distances are measured upstream from the toe. Vertical distances are measured up from the base.

**Layout:** the heel is at x = 0 and the toe at x = B = 11.56 m.
- Rectangle: from x = 0 to 3.3 m, full height 25.9 m.
- Triangle: from x = 3.3 m to 11.56 m, so its base is 8.26 m. It is vertical at x = 3.3 m and slopes down to zero height at the toe.

| Load | How the line of action is located | Lever arm about toe |
|---|---|---|
| W₁ (rectangle) | Centroid is at mid-width, 3.3/2 = 1.65 m from the heel. Distance from toe = 11.56 − 1.65 | **9.910 m** (horizontal) |
| W₂ (triangle) | Centroid is 1/3 of its base from its vertical side, i.e. 2/3 of 8.26 m from the toe: (2/3)(8.26) | **5.507 m** (horizontal) |
| P (water thrust) | Triangular hydrostatic pressure acts at h/3 above the base: 23.9/3 | **7.967 m** (vertical) |
| U (uplift) | Triangular pressure, maximum at the heel. Its centroid is B/3 from the heel, so 2B/3 from the toe: (2/3)(11.56) | **7.707 m** (horizontal) |

The upstream face is vertical, so there is no water weight resting on the dam.

## Forces (per metre length)

- W₁ = 24 × 3.3 × 25.9 = **2051.3 kN**
- W₂ = 24 × ½ × 8.26 × 25.9 = **2567.2 kN**
- P = ½ × 9.81 × 23.9² = **2801.8 kN**
- Uplift pressure at the heel = 0.86 × 9.81 × 23.9 = 201.6 kPa
- U = ½ × 201.6 × 11.56 = **1165.5 kN**

## Moments about the toe

**Resisting moments**
- W₁: 2051.3 × 9.910 = 20,328 kN·m
- W₂: 2567.2 × 5.507 = 14,137 kN·m
- **Total = 34,465 kN·m**

**Overturning moments**
- P: 2801.8 × 7.967 = 22,321 kN·m
- U: 1165.5 × 7.707 = 8,982 kN·m
- **Total = 31,303 kN·m**

## Result

**FS = 34,465 / 31,303 = 1.10 < 1.5**

The design fails the acceptance criterion. The main causes are:
- the slender base, with B/H ≈ 0.45 (base width to dam height);
- the high uplift factor of 0.86.

To meet the criterion, consider:
- widening the base, either by flattening the downstream slope or adding upstream batter so that water weight sits on the dam;
- reducing uplift with drainage or a grout curtain.

After any change, re-check the design, including sliding stability and the base-pressure (middle-third) requirement.

- Uplift pressure at the heel = 0.9 × 9.81 × 19.5 = 172.17 kPa
- U = ½ × 172.17 × 8.77 = 754.95 kN, giving M = 754.95 × 5.847 = 4,413.9 kN·m
- **ΣM_O = 16,537.2 kN·m**

## Result

FS_overturning = 18,660.1 / 16,537.2 = **1.13 < 1.5**

## Decision: REJECT

The section has only about 13% margin against overturning, well short of the 50% required. The main causes are:
- The base is narrow (B/H ≈ 0.40, compared with about 0.7–0.8 for typical gravity dams).
- The high uplift factor of 0.9 alone contributes about 27% of the overturning moment.

## Geometry and Lines of Action (moments about the toe)

I placed the heel (upstream face) at x = 0 and the toe at x = B = 13.27 m. The lever arm from the toe is 13.27 − x.

| Load | How located | Lever arm from toe |
|---|---|---|
| **W1, rectangle** (3.4 m × 31.7 m) | Centroid at mid-width, x = 3.4/2 = 1.70 m | 13.27 − 1.70 = **11.57 m** |
| **W2, downstream triangle** (base 13.27 − 3.4 = 9.87 m, height 31.7 m) | Vertical side at x = 3.4 m, apex at the toe. Centroid is 1/3 of the base from the vertical side: x = 3.4 + 9.87/3 = 6.69 m | 13.27 − 6.69 = **6.58 m** (= 2/3 × 9.87) |
| **P, horizontal water thrust** | Triangular pressure over a depth of 27.3 m, so the resultant acts at h/3 above the base | 27.3/3 = **9.10 m** (vertical arm) |
| **U, uplift** | Triangle with its maximum at the heel and zero at the toe. Centroid is B/3 from the heel | 2B/3 = **8.847 m** |

## Forces

- W1 = 24 × 3.4 × 31.7 = **2586.7 kN**
- W2 = 24 × ½ × 9.87 × 31.7 = **3754.5 kN**
- P = ½ × 9.81 × 27.3² = **3655.7 kN**
- Uplift pressure at the heel = 0.84 × 9.81 × 27.3 = 224.96 kPa
- U = ½ × 224.96 × 13.27 = **1492.6 kN**

**Resisting moments**
- W1: 2586.7 × 11.57 = 29,928 kN·m
- W2: 3754.5 × 6.58 = 24,705 kN·m
- **Total resisting moment ΣM_R = 54,633 kN·m**

**Overturning moments**
- P: 3655.7 × 9.10 = 33,266 kN·m
- U: 1492.6 × 8.847 = 13,205 kN·m
- **Total overturning moment ΣM_O = 46,471 kN·m**

FS_overturning = 54,633 / 46,471 = **1.18 < 1.5**

- P = ½ × 9.81 × 27.3² = **3655.6 kN**
- Uplift pressure at the heel = 0.84 × 9.81 × 27.3 = 224.96 kPa
- U = ½ × 224.96 × 13.27 = **1492.6 kN**

- W₂: 3754.5 × 6.58 = 24,705 kN·m

- P: 3655.6 × 9.10 = 33,266 kN·m
- U: 1492.6 × 8.847 = 13,205 kN·m

# Gravity Dam Overturning Check: **REJECT**

FS_overturning ≈ **1.09**, below the required 1.5.

## Coordinate set-up and lines of action

Moments are taken about the **toe** (downstream base corner). Horizontal lever arms are measured upstream from the toe, and vertical lever arms upward from the base.

- Base width B = 17.3 m. The heel is 17.3 m from the toe.
- The rectangle occupies the 3.8 m next to the heel. The downstream triangle has a base of 17.3 − 3.8 = **13.5 m** and a height of 38 m. Its vertical side is shared with the rectangle, and its hypotenuse runs down to the toe.

| Load | How located | Lever arm from toe |
|---|---|---|
| W₁ (rectangle) | Centroid at mid-width: 3.8/2 = 1.9 m from heel | 17.3 − 1.9 = **15.40 m** (horizontal) |
| W₂ (triangle) | Centroid at 1/3 of its base from the vertical side, so 2/3 of 13.5 m from the toe | **9.00 m** (horizontal) |
| P (water thrust) | Triangular pressure, so resultant at h/3 above base: 35.1/3 | **11.70 m** (vertical) |
| U (uplift) | Triangular, maximum at heel, so centroid at B/3 from heel, i.e. 2B/3 from toe | (2/3)(17.3) = **11.53 m** (horizontal) |

## Forces (per metre length)

- W₁ = 24 × 3.8 × 38 = **3,465.6 kN**
- W₂ = 24 × ½ × 13.5 × 38 = **6,156.0 kN**
- P = ½ × 9.81 × 35.1² = **6,043.0 kN**
- U = ½ × 0.84 × 9.81 × 35.1 × 17.3 = **2,501.9 kN**
  - Heel uplift pressure = 0.84 × 9.81 × 35.1 = 289.2 kPa.

## Moments about the toe

**Resisting moments**
- W₁: 3,465.6 × 15.40 = 53,370 kN·m
- W₂: 6,156.0 × 9.00 = 55,404 kN·m
- **Total = 108,774 kN·m**

**Overturning moments**
- P: 6,043.0 × 11.70 = 70,703 kN·m
- U: 2,501.9 × 11.53 = 28,855 kN·m
- **Total = 99,559 kN·m**

## Result

FS_overturning = 108,774 / 99,559 = **1.09 < 1.5**, so the criterion is **not met**.

## Comment

The section is far too slender for a 35 m water depth. The base width to height ratio is about 0.46, whereas gravity dams typically need about 0.7–0.8. The high uplift factor of 0.84 also adds roughly 29% to the overturning moment.

The design could be improved by:
- widening the base substantially, and/or
- reducing uplift, for example with drainage galleries and a grout curtain.

Sliding and the resultant's position within the middle third should also be checked. With e far outside B/6 here, tension at the heel is very likely.

All moments are taken about the **toe**. Lever arms are horizontal distances from the toe for vertical forces, and heights above the base for horizontal forces.

| U (uplift) | The pressure diagram is triangular, with its maximum at the heel. The resultant acts at B/3 from the heel, which is ⅔B from the toe. | ⅔ × 17.3 = **11.53 m** |

- U: 318.0 × 4.327 = 1376.0 kN·m

# Gravity Dam Overturning Check: **REJECT**

The factor of safety against overturning is about **1.13**, below the required 1.5.

## Geometry and lines of action

Moments are taken about the **toe**, the downstream edge of the base. I set up coordinates with the heel (upstream edge) at x = 0, the toe at x = B = 16.35 m, and y measured upward from the base.

- **Rectangle (crest block):** occupies x = 0 to 3.3 m and has the full 37.7 m height. Its centroid is at mid-width, x = 1.65 m.
  - Lever arm from the toe = 16.35 − 1.65 = **14.70 m**
- **Downstream triangle:** occupies x = 3.3 to 16.35 m, so its base is 13.05 m. It is 37.7 m tall at x = 3.3 m and tapers to zero at the toe. A triangle's centroid lies one-third of its base from the vertical side, so x = 3.3 + 13.05/3 = 7.65 m.
  - Lever arm from the toe = (2/3)(13.05) = **8.70 m**
- **Water thrust:** horizontal and acting on the vertical upstream face. Hydrostatic pressure is a triangle with zero at the surface and a maximum at the base, so the resultant acts at h/3 above the base.
  - Lever arm = 33.7/3 = **11.233 m** (vertical, above the toe level)
- **Uplift:** triangular, with its maximum at the heel and zero at the toe. Its centroid is B/3 from the heel.
  - Lever arm from the toe = (2/3)(16.35) = **10.90 m**

## Forces (per metre length)

| Load | Calculation | Force (kN) | Arm (m) | Moment (kN·m) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| W₁ rectangle | 24 × 3.3 × 37.7 | 2,985.8 | 14.70 | 43,891.8 |
| W₂ triangle | 24 × ½ × 13.05 × 37.7 | 5,903.8 | 8.70 | 51,363.2 |
| **Resisting total** | | | | **95,255.1** |
| P water | ½ × 9.81 × 33.7² | 5,570.6 | 11.233 | 62,576.0 |
| U uplift | ½ × (0.74 × 9.81 × 33.7) × 16.35 | 2,000.0 | 10.90 | 21,799.5 |
| **Overturning total** | | | | **84,375.5** |

For the uplift, the pressure at the heel is 0.74 × 9.81 × 33.7 = 244.6 kPa.

FS = 95,255.1 / 84,375.5 = **1.13 < 1.5**

- thickening the crest; or

# Gravity Dam Overturning Check: **REJECT**

FS against overturning is about **1.30**, below the required 1.5.

## 1. Lines of action (moments taken about the toe)

I placed the heel at x = 0 and the toe at x = B = 18.92 m. Lever arms are perpendicular distances from the toe.

| Load | How located | Lever arm from toe |
|---|---|---|
| **W₁, rectangle** (3.4 m × 35.5 m) | Centroid at mid-width, x = 1.70 m from the heel. Arm = 18.92 − 1.70 | **17.22 m** (horizontal) |
| **W₂, downstream triangle** (base 18.92 − 3.4 = 15.52 m, height 35.5 m) | Vertical side at x = 3.4 m, apex at the toe. Centroid lies b/3 from the vertical side: x = 3.4 + 5.173 = 8.573 m. Arm = 18.92 − 8.573 (equivalently 2/3 × 15.52) | **10.347 m** (horizontal) |
| **P, water thrust** (horizontal) | Triangular hydrostatic pressure, so the resultant acts at h/3 above the base: 32.3/3 | **10.767 m** (vertical) |
| **U, uplift** (vertical, upward) | Triangle with its maximum at the heel and zero at the toe. Centroid is B/3 from the heel, so 2B/3 from the toe: 2/3 × 18.92 | **12.613 m** (horizontal) |

## 2. Forces and moments (per metre length)

**Resisting:**
- W₁ = 24 × 3.4 × 35.5 = 2,896.8 kN, giving M = 2,896.8 × 17.22 = **49,883 kN·m**
- W₂ = 24 × ½ × 15.52 × 35.5 = 6,611.5 kN, giving M = 6,611.5 × 10.347 = **68,407 kN·m**
- **ΣM_R = 118,290 kN·m**

**Overturning:**
- P = ½ × 9.81 × 32.3² = 5,117.3 kN, giving M = 5,117.3 × 10.767 = **55,097 kN·m**
- Uplift pressure at the heel = 0.95 × 9.81 × 32.3 = 301.0 kPa
- U = ½ × 301.0 × 18.92 = 2,847.7 kN, giving M = 2,847.7 × 12.613 = **35,918 kN·m**
- **ΣM_O = 91,015 kN·m**

## 3. Factor of safety

FS = 118,290 / 91,015 = **1.30 < 1.5**

## Conclusion: **REJECT**

The section does not meet the overturning criterion. The main contributors are:
- **Uplift.** It supplies about 40% of the overturning moment. A factor of 0.95 means essentially full uplift, with no drainage benefit.
- **A slender base.** B/H is about 0.53, while typical gravity dams use about 0.7–0.8.

Possible remedies, to be re-checked:
- Widen the base. Roughly B ≈ 22–23 m would be needed under the same uplift assumption.
- Install a foundation drainage gallery and grout curtain to reduce the uplift factor. Any reduction must be justified per the governing design criteria.
- Re-verify sliding and the no-tension (middle-third) check for any revised section.

|---|---|---|
| **W₁, rectangle** (4.1 × 35.1) | Centroid is at mid-width, 4.1/2 = 2.05 m from the heel. Arm = 16.79 − 2.05 | **14.74 m** |

| **U, uplift** (triangular, maximum at heel) | Centroid of the triangle is B/3 from the heel, which is 2B/3 from the toe: ⅔ × 16.79 | **11.19 m** |

## 2. Forces

- W₁ = 24 × 4.1 × 35.1 = **3,453.8 kN**
- W₂ = 24 × ½ × 12.69 × 35.1 = **5,345.0 kN**
- P = ½ × 9.81 × 32.5² = **5,180.9 kN**
- Uplift pressure at the heel = 0.62 × 9.81 × 32.5 = 197.7 kPa
- U = ½ × 197.7 × 16.79 = **1,659.4 kN**

- W₁: 3,453.8 × 14.74 = 50,910 kN·m
- W₂: 5,345.0 × 8.46 = 45,219 kN·m
- **Total resisting = 96,129 kN·m**

- P: 5,180.9 × 10.83 = 56,126 kN·m
- U: 1,659.4 × 11.19 = 18,574 kN·m
- **Total overturning = 74,700 kN·m**

FS = 96,129 / 74,700 = **1.29 < 1.5**

## Decision: **REJECT**

The section has only about 86% of the required resisting moment. To reach FS = 1.5, the resisting moment would need to be about 112,050 kN·m, roughly 16,000 kN·m more than at present. Possible remedies:

- W₁ = 24 × 4.1 × 35.1 = 3,453.8 kN, giving M = 3,453.8 × 14.74 = 50,910 kN·m
- W₂ = 24 × ½ × 12.69 × 35.1 = 5,345.0 kN, giving M = 5,345.0 × 8.46 = 45,219 kN·m

The factor of safety against overturning is **FS ≈ 1.25**, below the required 1.5.

## Lines of action (moments about the toe)

Coordinates are measured horizontally from the heel (upstream face, x = 0). The toe is at x = B = 14.82 m. The rectangle spans x = 0 to 4.9 m. The downstream triangle spans x = 4.9 to 14.82 m, so its base is 9.92 m. Its vertical side is at x = 4.9 m and its sloping face meets the base at the toe.

| Load | How located | Lever arm from toe |
|---|---|---|
| W₁, rectangle weight | Centroid at mid-width of crest block: x = 4.9/2 = 2.45 m | 14.82 − 2.45 = **12.37 m** |
| W₂, triangle weight | Centroid at 1/3 of the triangle's base from its vertical side: x = 4.9 + 9.92/3 = 8.207 m | 14.82 − 8.207 = **6.613 m** (= ⅔ × 9.92) |
| P, water thrust (horizontal) | Triangular pressure on the vertical face, so the resultant acts at h/3 above the base | 29.1/3 = **9.70 m** (vertical arm) |
| U, uplift (vertical, upward) | Triangle with its maximum at the heel, so the centroid is B/3 from the heel | 14.82 − 4.94 = **9.88 m** (= ⅔B) |

**Resisting moments**

- W₁ = 4.9 × 32 × 24 = 3763.2 kN, giving M = 3763.2 × 12.37 = 46,551 kN·m
- W₂ = ½ × 9.92 × 32 × 24 = 3809.3 kN, giving M = 3809.3 × 6.613 = 25,192 kN·m
- **ΣM_R = 71,743 kN·m**

**Overturning moments**

- P = ½ × 9.81 × 29.1² = 4153.6 kN, giving M = 4153.6 × 9.70 = 40,290 kN·m
- Uplift pressure at the heel = 0.82 × 9.81 × 29.1 = 234.09 kPa
- U = ½ × 234.09 × 14.82 = 1734.6 kN, giving M = 1734.6 × 9.88 = 17,138 kN·m
- **ΣM_O = 57,428 kN·m**

## Result

FS_overturning = 71,743 / 57,428 = **1.25**, which is less than the required 1.5.

## Conclusion: REJECT

The section does not meet the overturning criterion. The shortfall is significant: resisting moments would need to rise by about 20% to reach FS = 1.5.

# Gravity Dam Overturning Check: **REJECT**

**FS_overturning = 1.28, below the required 1.5.**

## Reference point and geometry

Moments are taken about the **toe**, the downstream end of the base. To locate each load, I set x = 0 at the heel (upstream base corner), so the toe is at x = 16.84 m.

- **Rectangle:** 5.2 m wide × 38.7 m high, from x = 0 to x = 5.2 m.
- **Triangle:** base 16.84 − 5.2 = 11.64 m, height 38.7 m. Its vertical side is at x = 5.2 m and it slopes down to the toe.

## Lines of action, measured from the toe

| Load | Direction | How the line of action was located | Lever arm |
|---|---|---|---|
| W₁, rectangle weight | Down, resisting | Centroid at mid-width, x = 2.6 m. Arm = 16.84 − 2.6 | **14.24 m** |
| W₂, triangle weight | Down, resisting | Centroid is ⅓ of the triangle base from its vertical side, x = 5.2 + 3.88 = 9.08 m. Arm = 16.84 − 9.08 (equals ⅔ × 11.64) | **7.76 m** |
| P, water thrust | Horizontal, overturning | Triangular hydrostatic pressure. Resultant acts at h/3 above the base: 34.3/3. Arm is vertical. | **11.433 m** |
| U, uplift | Up, overturning | Triangle with its maximum at the heel. Centroid is B/3 from the heel, so 2B/3 from the toe: ⅔ × 16.84 | **11.227 m** |

The upstream face is vertical, so no water rests on the dam and there is no vertical water load.

## Forces and moments

**Resisting moments**
- W₁ = 24 × 5.2 × 38.7 = 4,829.8 kN, giving M = 4,829.8 × 14.24 = 68,775.8 kN·m
- W₂ = 24 × ½ × 11.64 × 38.7 = 5,405.6 kN, giving M = 5,405.6 × 7.76 = 41,947.6 kN·m
- **Total resisting moment = 110,723 kN·m**

**Overturning moments**
- P = ½ × 9.81 × 34.3² = 5,770.7 kN, giving M = 5,770.7 × 11.433 = 65,978.2 kN·m
- U = ½ × 0.65 × 9.81 × 34.3 × 16.84 = 1,841.6 kN, giving M = 1,841.6 × 11.227 = 20,674.8 kN·m
- **Total overturning moment = 86,653 kN·m**

## Result

FS = 110,723 / 86,653 = **1.28 < 1.5**, so the design does not meet the acceptance criterion and should be rejected.

The section is too slender for a 34.3 m reservoir. To approach FS ≥ 1.5 the designer could:
- widen the base, which lengthens both weight lever arms and adds mass;
- add drainage to lower the uplift factor;
- thicken the crest.

The revised section would then need to be rechecked.

FS_overturning ≈ **1.28**, which is below the required **1.5**.

## 1. Geometry and Lines of Action (moments about the toe)

- **Rectangle (crest block):** occupies x = 0 to 5.2 m over the full 38.7 m height. Its centroid is at mid-width, x = 2.6 m. Lever arm = 16.84 − 2.6 = **14.24 m**.
- **Downstream triangle:** base 16.84 − 5.2 = 11.64 m, height 38.7 m. Its vertical edge is at x = 5.2 m and it tapers to zero at the toe. A triangle's centroid lies 1/3 of the base from its vertical edge, so x = 5.2 + 3.88 = 9.08 m. Lever arm = 16.84 − 9.08 = **7.76 m** (equivalently, 2/3 × 11.64).
- **Water thrust:** horizontal, with triangular pressure over depth h = 34.3 m. The resultant acts at h/3 above the base. Lever arm = 34.3/3 = **11.433 m**.
- **Uplift:** triangular, maximum at the heel and zero at the toe. The resultant acts at B/3 from the heel, so lever arm = 2B/3 = **11.227 m** from the toe.

## 2. Forces and Moments (per metre length)

| Load | Force (kN) | Arm (m) | Moment (kN·m) |
|---|---|---|---|
| W₁ = 24 × 5.2 × 38.7 | 4,829.8 | 14.24 | 68,775.8 (R) |
| W₂ = 24 × ½ × 11.64 × 38.7 | 5,405.6 | 7.76 | 41,947.6 (R) |
| P = ½ × 9.81 × 34.3² | 5,770.7 | 11.433 | 65,978.2 (O) |
| U = ½ × (0.65 × 9.81 × 34.3) × 16.84 | 1,841.6 | 11.227 | 20,674.7 (O) |

- Total overturning moment: ΣM_O = **86,653 kN·m**

FS = 110,723 / 86,653 = **1.28 < 1.5**

The section falls about 15% short of the required factor of safety. The water thrust alone produces 60% of the resisting moment. Possible remedies, each of which needs re-checking:

- Lower the maximum reservoir level.

- U = ½ × 174.14 × 14.03 = **1,221.6 kN**

- **Total = 64,206 kN·m**

- P: 4,153.6 × 9.700 = 40,290 kN·m
- U: 1,221.6 × 9.353 = 11,426 kN·m
- **Total = 51,716 kN·m**

FS_overturning = 64,206 / 51,716 = **1.24 < 1.5**

| **W₂** downstream triangle (base 9.42, height 28.4) | Vertical side at x = 4.3, sloping face down to the toe | Centroid is ⅓ of its base from the vertical side: x = 4.3 + 9.42/3 = 7.44 m from heel. Equivalently, ⅔ × 9.42 from the toe. | **6.28 m** (horizontal) |
| **P** water thrust | Triangular hydrostatic pressure on the vertical face, zero at the surface and maximum at the base | Resultant acts at h/3 above the base: 26.8/3 | **8.933 m** (vertical) |
| **U** uplift | Triangle on the base, maximum at the heel, zero at the toe | Centroid is B/3 from the heel (the large end), so 2B/3 from the toe: ⅔ × 13.72 | **9.147 m** (horizontal) |

## 2. Forces (per metre length)

- W₂ = 24 × ½ × 9.42 × 28.4 = **3210.3 kN**
- P = ½ × 9.81 × 26.8² = **3523.0 kN**
- Uplift pressure at the heel = 0.77 × 9.81 × 26.8 = 202.4 kPa
- U = ½ × 202.4 × 13.72 = **1388.7 kN**

## 3. Moments about the toe

**Resisting moments**

- W₁: 2930.9 × 11.57 = 33,910 kN·m/m
- W₂: 3210.3 × 6.28 = 20,161 kN·m/m
- **Total resisting = 54,071 kN·m/m**

**Overturning moments**

- P: 3523.0 × 8.933 = 31,472 kN·m/m
- U: 1388.7 × 9.147 = 12,702 kN·m/m
- **Total overturning = 44,174 kN·m/m**

## 4. Factor of safety

FS = 54,071 / 44,174 = **1.22 < 1.5**

## Decision: **REJECT**

The section has only about 82% of the required resisting capacity against overturning. Uplift alone contributes about 29% of the overturning moment. The base is relatively narrow at roughly 0.48 H, where typical gravity sections are about 0.7–0.8 H.

- Widen the base. A wider downstream triangle adds weight and gives the weights a longer lever arm.
- Reduce uplift with drainage galleries or a grout curtain, which lowers the uplift factor.
- Combine both measures.

# Gravity Dam Overturning Check: **REJECT**

**FS_overturning = 1.26, below the required 1.5.**

## Geometry and Reference Point

- Moments are taken about the **toe**, the downstream base corner.
- x is measured from the heel (upstream base corner), so the toe is at x = 19.6 m.
- The rectangle spans x = 0 to 3.2 m and is 36.3 m high.
- The downstream triangle spans x = 3.2 to 19.6 m (width 16.4 m). It is 36.3 m high at x = 3.2 m and tapers to zero at the toe.

## Lines of Action (Lever Arms About the Toe)

| Load | Direction | How located | Lever arm from toe |
|---|---|---|---|
| W₁: rectangle | Vertical, down | Centroid at mid-crest-width, x = 1.6 m | 19.6 − 1.6 = **18.000 m** (horizontal) |
| W₂: triangle | Vertical, down | Centroid is ⅓ of 16.4 m from the vertical side (x = 3.2 m), so x = 8.667 m. Equivalently, ⅔ of 16.4 m from the toe. | **10.933 m** (horizontal) |
| P: water thrust | Horizontal, downstream | Triangular pressure on the vertical face; resultant at h/3 above the base | 34.4/3 = **11.467 m** (vertical) |
| U: uplift | Vertical, up | Triangle with its maximum at the heel; centroid at B/3 from the heel, so 2B/3 from the toe | ⅔ × 19.6 = **13.067 m** (horizontal) |

## Forces (per metre length)

- W₁ = 3.2 × 36.3 × 24 = **2,787.8 kN**
- W₂ = ½ × 16.4 × 36.3 × 24 = **7,143.8 kN**
- P = ½ × 9.81 × 34.4² = **5,804.4 kN**
- U: heel pressure = 0.81 × 9.81 × 34.4 = 273.3 kPa, so U = ½ × 273.3 × 19.6 = **2,678.8 kN**

## Moments About the Toe

**Resisting moments:**
- W₁: 2,787.8 × 18.000 = 50,181 kN·m
- W₂: 7,143.8 × 10.933 = 78,106 kN·m
- **Total resisting: 128,287 kN·m**

**Overturning moments:**
- P: 5,804.4 × 11.467 = 66,557 kN·m
- U: 2,678.8 × 13.067 = 35,003 kN·m
- **Total overturning: 101,560 kN·m**

## Result

**FS = 128,287 / 101,560 = 1.26 < 1.5. The design fails the overturning check.**

Uplift makes up about 34% of the overturning moment. Either of these changes would raise the FS:

- Widen the base, which adds weight and lengthens the resisting lever arms.
- Reduce uplift with drainage or a grout curtain. Removing about 26,000 kN·m of overturning moment would be needed, which means an uplift factor of roughly 0.2 if uplift reduction were the only change.

Recheck the design after any revision.

# Gravity Dam Overturning Check: **REJECT**

**FS_overturning = 1.47, below the required 1.5.**

## Geometry and Reference Point

- The heel (upstream, vertical face) is at x = 0. The toe is at x = 14.02 m.
- Moments are taken about the **toe**. Every lever arm below is measured from the toe.
- The rectangle runs from x = 0 to 3.1 m and is 28 m high.
- The downstream triangle has its vertical side at x = 3.1 m, a base of 14.02 − 3.1 = 10.92 m, and slopes down to the toe.

## Lines of Action (located before computing)

| Load | How located | Lever arm from toe |
|---|---|---|
| W₁ (rectangle) | Centroid at mid-width, x = 1.55 m from heel | 14.02 − 1.55 = **12.47 m** |
| W₂ (triangle) | Centroid at 1/3 of its base from the vertical side, x = 3.1 + 3.64 = 6.74 m from heel. This equals 2/3 of 10.92 from the toe. | **7.28 m** |
| P (water thrust) | Triangular hydrostatic pressure, so the resultant acts at h/3 above the base: 24.1/3 | **8.033 m** (vertical arm) |
| U (uplift) | Triangular pressure, maximum at heel, so the resultant is at B/3 from the heel. This equals 2B/3 from the toe. | **9.347 m** |

## Forces and Moments (per m length)

**Resisting moments:**
- W₁ = 24 × 3.1 × 28 = 2083.2 kN. Moment = 2083.2 × 12.47 = 25,977 kN·m.
- W₂ = 24 × ½ × 10.92 × 28 = 3669.1 kN. Moment = 3669.1 × 7.28 = 26,711 kN·m.
- **Total resisting moment = 52,689 kN·m.**

**Overturning moments:**
- P = ½ × 9.81 × 24.1² = 2848.9 kN. Moment = 2848.9 × 8.033 = 22,886 kN·m.
- Heel uplift pressure = 0.83 × 9.81 × 24.1 = 196.2 kPa.
- U = ½ × 196.2 × 14.02 = 1375.6 kN. Moment = 1375.6 × 9.347 = 12,857 kN·m.
- **Total overturning moment = 35,743 kN·m.**

## Result

FS_overturning = 52,689 / 35,743 = **1.47 < 1.5**

## Conclusion

The design fails the overturning criterion. It falls about 2% short, which is a deficit of roughly 950 kN·m of resisting moment.

Uplift contributes over a third of the overturning moment. Possible remedies include:
- reducing the uplift factor with drainage galleries or a grout curtain,
- widening the base slightly, or
- increasing the crest width.

Any revised section should be rechecked.

# Gravity Dam Overturning Check: **REJECT**

**FS_overturning = 1.48 < 1.5 required.** The design fails, though only by a small margin (about 1.3%).

## Reference frame and lines of action

Moments are taken about the **toe** (downstream base corner).

- x is measured horizontally from the heel (upstream base corner) toward the toe. The toe is at x = B = 12.07 m.
- Horizontal lever arms about the toe are (12.07 − x).
- Vertical lever arms are heights above the base.

**Geometry:**

- The rectangle spans x = 0 to 4.2 m and is 24.2 m high.
- The triangle spans x = 4.2 to 12.07 m, so its base is 7.87 m. Its vertical side is at x = 4.2 m, and its sloping face runs down to the toe.

**Lines of action:**

| Load | How it was located | Lever arm about toe |
|---|---|---|
| W₁ (rectangle) | Centroid at mid-width, x = 4.2/2 = 2.10 m | 12.07 − 2.10 = **9.970 m** (horizontal) |
| W₂ (triangle) | Centroid is 1/3 of the base from the vertical side: x = 4.2 + 7.87/3 = 6.823 m | 12.07 − 6.823 = **5.247 m** (= ⅔ × 7.87) |
| P (water thrust) | Triangular pressure on the vertical face, so the resultant is at h/3 above the base: 22.5/3 | **7.500 m** (vertical) |
| U (uplift) | Triangular pressure, maximum at the heel, so the centroid is B/3 from the heel: x = 4.023 m | 12.07 − 4.023 = **8.047 m** (= ⅔B) |

## Forces and moments (per metre length)

**Resisting moments:**

- W₁ = 24 × 4.2 × 24.2 = 2439.36 kN, giving M = 2439.36 × 9.970 = **24,320 kN·m**
- W₂ = 24 × ½ × 7.87 × 24.2 = 2285.45 kN, giving M = 2285.45 × 5.247 = **11,991 kN·m**
- **ΣM_R = 36,311 kN·m**

**Overturning moments:**

- P = ½ × 9.81 × 22.5² = 2483.16 kN, giving M = 2483.16 × 7.5 = **18,624 kN·m**
- U = ½ × 0.55 × 9.81 × 22.5 × 12.07 = 732.64 kN, giving M = 732.64 × 8.047 = **5,895 kN·m**
- **ΣM_O = 24,519 kN·m**

FS = 36,311 / 24,519 = **1.481**

This is below the required 1.5. The design does not meet the acceptance criterion.

## Remedies to consider

- Widen the base slightly. Roughly 12.3 m or more would likely be sufficient; re-check this with the same method.

The moment point is the **toe**, at the downstream end of the base. Horizontal lever arms are measured upstream from the toe, and vertical lever arms upward from the base. Base width B = 14.11 m, so the heel is 14.11 m from the toe.

| Load | How located | Lever arm about toe |
|---|---|---|
| **W₁: rectangle** (5.7 m × 33.3 m, against the upstream face) | Centroid at mid-width, 5.7/2 = 2.85 m from the heel | 14.11 − 2.85 = **11.26 m** (horizontal) |
| **W₂: downstream triangle** (base 14.11 − 5.7 = 8.41 m, height 33.3 m; vertical side at x = 5.7 m, apex at the toe) | Centroid is 1/3 of the base from the vertical side, which is 2/3 of the base from the toe | (2/3)(8.41) = **5.607 m** (horizontal) |
| **P: water thrust** (triangular pressure, depth 28.6 m) | Resultant at h/3 above the base | 28.6/3 = **9.533 m** (vertical) |
| **U: uplift** (triangular, maximum at the heel, zero at the toe) | Resultant at B/3 from the heel, which is 2B/3 from the toe | (2/3)(14.11) = **9.407 m** (horizontal) |

## 2. Forces and moments (per metre run)

**Resisting moments**
- W₁ = 24 × 5.7 × 33.3 = 4555.4 kN, so M = 4555.4 × 11.26 = **51,294 kN·m**
- W₂ = 24 × ½ × 8.41 × 33.3 = 3360.6 kN, so M = 3360.6 × 5.607 = **18,842 kN·m**
- **ΣM_R = 70,136 kN·m**

- **ΣM_O = 47,744 kN·m**

FS = 70,136 / 47,744 = **1.469**, which is less than 1.5.

The section falls about 2% short of the overturning criterion. The shortfall is small, so modest changes should fix it. Each of these options would need to be re-checked:

# Gravity Dam Overturning Check: **REJECT**

FS_overturning = **1.48**, which is below the required 1.5.

## Coordinate set-up and lines of action

All moments are taken about the **toe**, the downstream base corner. Horizontal distances are measured from the toe toward the heel. Vertical distances are measured from the base.

- Heel at x = 0 (upstream). Toe at x = B = 17.11 m.
- Rectangle: from x = 0 to 4 m, height 33 m.
- Triangle: vertical side at x = 4 m, sloping to the toe. Its base is 17.11 − 4 = 13.11 m and its height is 33 m.

| Load | How located | Lever arm about toe |
|---|---|---|
| W₁ (rectangle) | Centroid at mid-width, x = 2 m from heel | 17.11 − 2 = **15.11 m** |
| W₂ (triangle) | Centroid is 1/3 of its base from the vertical side (x = 4 + 4.37 = 8.37 m), so 2/3 of its base from the toe | (2/3)(13.11) = **8.74 m** |
| P (water thrust) | Triangular hydrostatic pressure, so the resultant acts at h/3 above the base | 29.2/3 = **9.733 m** (vertical arm) |
| U (uplift) | Triangular, maximum at heel, so the resultant acts at B/3 from the heel | (2/3)(17.11) = **11.407 m** |

## Forces (per metre run)

- W₁ = 24 × 4 × 33 = **3168.0 kN**
- W₂ = 24 × ½ × 13.11 × 33 = **5191.6 kN**
- P = ½ × 9.81 × 29.2² = **4182.2 kN**
- U = ½ × (0.8 × 9.81 × 29.2) × 17.11 = ½ × 229.16 × 17.11 = **1960.5 kN**

## Moments about the toe

**Resisting moments:**
- W₁: 3168.0 × 15.11 = 47,868 kN·m
- W₂: 5191.6 × 8.74 = 45,374 kN·m
- **Total resisting moment ΣM_R = 93,243 kN·m**

**Overturning moments:**
- P: 4182.2 × 9.733 = 40,707 kN·m
- U: 1960.5 × 11.407 = 22,362 kN·m
- **Total overturning moment ΣM_O = 63,069 kN·m**

## Factor of safety

FS = 93,243 / 63,069 = **1.478**, which is less than 1.5.

## Decision: **REJECT**

The section falls about 1.5% short of the criterion. The deficit is driven mainly by the uplift moment, which is about 35% of the total overturning moment. Possible fixes:

- Widen the base slightly. This adds weight with a longer lever arm.
- Provide drainage to reduce the uplift factor. For example, reducing it to about 0.7 would bring FS above 1.5.
- Lower the maximum reservoir level.

The revised section should then be re-checked, including sliding and base stresses (resultant within the middle third).
